headline: AADE: Application for alternative taxation of non-resident pensioners open until 31/10
summary: The deadline for applications for alternative taxation of non-resident pensioners in Greece has been moved from March 31 to October 31. Taxpayers gain seven additional months.
why: Tax rules for non-resident pensioners affect individual tax liabilities and the scope of Greece's tax regime for foreign-sourced pension income.
